title: Simpsley
plot_overview: A penniless con artist travels to Italy to persuade a wealthy man to return home, but his affluent lifestyle proves tempting. Her plans are complicated by his clingy, dim-witted houseguest, setting the stage for a comedy of lies, lust, and money.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like comic schemes, awkward houseguest dynamics, and a setting filled with Italian charm; Not for you if you prefer serious stories or straightforward relationships.
review_summary: Pros: Italian setting; con-artist comedy; tangled relationships | Cons: no review feedback; plot leans on deception
